summary.text: Beth Bernstein is a Democratic state representative from Richland County who has represented South Carolina House District 78 since 2013 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney and partner at Bernstein and Bernstein Attorneys at Law, Bernstein serves on the Judiciary and Ethics committees.

paragraphs.text: Bernstein earned a B.A. from the University of Georgia in 1991 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina in 1994.
She is an attorney and partner in the firm Bernstein and Bernstein and served as president of the Richland County Bar Association in 2009.

Her biography also lists service on the boards of the South Carolina Philharmonic, the Columbia Jewish Day School and the Palmetto Health Foundation Cancer Center, and recognition as one of The State's "Top 20 under 40" in 2006.
In the House, Bernstein is listed as secretary of the Ethics Committee and as a member of the Judiciary Committee.
In the November 3 general election she faces Republican Sonia Pollard and Libertarian Angelo Joyner.
